fusions.name: Chilled Thread
fusions.desc: Casts a cold strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Stillness
fusions.desc: A sudden lash that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A shed strand fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed
fusions.desc: During the day, your armour rises by 12%.
